Exercise: Incline Dumbbell Curl

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- elbow_flexion

Primary Muscles:

- biceps

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- dumbbell

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- biceps_hypertrophy
- elbow_flexor_strength

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Concentration Curl, instructions: ['Sit on a flat bench with one dumbbell in your hand and rest the back of your arm against the inside of your thigh for support. Keep your elbow stationary and curl the weight towards your shoulder.']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Barbell Curl, equipment: barbell

Instructions:

- Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand held at arms length. Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward. This will be your starting position.
- While holding the upper arm stationary, curl the weights forward while contracting the biceps as you breathe out. Only the forearms should move. Continue the movement until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a second.
- Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to starting position as your breathe in.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
